adc16d08ef.substituent_description: Fused bicyclic: a five-membered ring containing N (N bears Ac, attached to a ring-fusion carbon) fused to a six-membered ring drawn with an aromatic circle and one ring N. In the five-membered ring the carbon next to the other (lower) fusion carbon carries EtOOC; in the six-membered ring the carbon directly adjacent to the ring N (on the side away from the fusion carbon that is attached to N-Ac) carries OMe.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Ac is written with a capital-looking C, read as Ac
adc16d08ef.notes: Handwritten photo. Six-membered ring contains N at the position meta to the upper fusion carbon; OMe is on the carbon alpha to that N.

b2ffb616b2.substituent_description: Para-disubstituted benzene ring: OPh on one ring carbon and a CH2 on the carbon directly opposite (para). The CH2 connects to a stereocentre carbon that bears NHBoc (plain bond, upward) and MeOOC (hashed wedge bond, to the left).
b2ffb616b2.notes: Typeset. Hashed wedge runs from the stereocentre carbon to the MeOOC label.

8e0448b408.substituent_description: Purine-like bicycle: six-membered ring with an aromatic circle and two ring N atoms; the carbon between the two N atoms carries COOtBu and the carbon at the opposite lower-left corner carries NH2. The five-membered ring (N=CH drawn with one double bond) has its N at the junction side joined by a solid wedge to a cyclohexane carbon; the adjacent (ortho, 1,2) cyclohexane carbon carries BocNH on a hashed wedge, and the cyclohexane carbon para (1,4) to the N-bearing carbon carries CO2H on a hashed bond.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: bond between the lower-right fusion carbon and the imidazole N may be drawn doubled or overdrawn, counted as single
five-membered ring has one double bond drawn (N=C) while the six-membered ring is a circle
8e0448b408.notes: Handwritten, scanned. Cyclohexane is a plain six-membered ring with three stereo bonds: solid wedge to N, hashed to BocNH, hashed to CO2H.

0437307d9d.substituent_description: Left to right: pyrrolidine N bonded to a C(=O) that bonds to NH, then a CH2CH2 chain to one N of a six-membered diaza ring (N at 1,4 positions) whose other N is bonded to a benzene ring (circle). That benzene carries, meta to the N, an O-CH2 group going by a hashed bond to a five-membered ring with two O atoms (dioxolane); the ring carbon between the two O atoms bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and Cl para to the ring attachment) and a hashed bond to CH2 attached to N of a five-membered ring with two N atoms (imidazole, two double bonds drawn).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: central N-containing ring has a long left edge, could be read as six or seven-membered; counted as six
double bonds in the imidazole drawn as close double strokes
0437307d9d.notes: Handwritten, long horizontal layout. Double bonds counted: carbonyl C=O, and two in the imidazole (one C=N, one C=C). Two hashed wedges, no solid wedges.

6cd6b42df5.substituent_description: Fused bicycle of a five-membered ring (one N, carbon bearing I next to that N) and a six-membered ring with two N atoms and a ring C=O; the ring N next to the C=O is joined through a CH2 to the 4-position of a piperidine that also carries HO on the same carbon. The piperidine N is bonded to a C(=O) which is attached via a solid wedge to a second piperidine ring carbon; the adjacent ring carbon bears Ph on a hashed wedge, and that ring N carries Boc.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: iodine label is a bare vertical stroke, read as I
possible N=C double bond in the six-membered ring top right is faint
hashed wedge to Ph is a dense fan of lines
6cd6b42df5.notes: Handwritten, scanned. Double bonds counted: two C=O, one in the five-membered ring, one at the ring fusion, one C=N in the six-membered ring.

2ab46bead4.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (aromatic circle) is para-substituted with AcNH and a sulfonyl group S(=O)2; the S is bonded to an N that carries a CH2-Bn and a CH2-C(=O)-NH-N=CH chain. The CH= carbon is attached to the 3-position of a pyrrole bearing methyl groups at both carbons next to the ring N (2,5-dimethyl), and the pyrrole N is bonded to a 2,4-dimethylphenyl ring (methyl ortho and methyl para to the attachment).
2ab46bead4.notes: Typeset. Methyl groups are unlabelled line stubs (four in total). Double bonds: two S=O, one C=O, one C=N, two in pyrrole, three in the right aryl ring (Kekule), while the left benzene uses a circle.

cef9f795ec.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (circle) has Cl and the ring-N attachment on carbons separated by one carbon (meta, 1,3). The five-membered ring contains N, N, a C=O carbon, an NH and a C=N carbon; the ring carbon doubly bonded to N carries an exocyclic NH linked to a second benzene ring (circle) that bears CO2H para (1,4) to the NH.
cef9f795ec.notes: Handwritten, scanned. Double bonds: C=O and the ring C=N.

50310605c6.substituent_description: Spiro carbon shared by an N-Boc pyrrolidine ring and a five-membered lactam ring (C=O, N) that is fused to a pyridine ring whose ring N is adjacent to the fusion carbon bonded to the lactam N. The lactam N carries a CH2 attached to a benzene ring bearing OMe para (1,4) to the CH2.
50310605c6.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: one C=O, three in the pyridine ring, three in the benzene ring.
